description: This source file defines a JavaScript module that provides an API client wrapper with functions for fetching job listings, user profiles, mock tests, and submitting mock test attempts. It uses fetch to make HTTP requests, handles configuration defaults, and manages errors and responses.

methods.name: request(path, { method = "GET", body, headers = {}, signal } = {})
methods.description: A helper function that performs HTTP requests with default headers, error handling, and response parsing.

methods.name: listJobs({ q, location, type, level, page, pageSize } = {})
methods.description: Fetches a list of job postings with optional search parameters.

methods.name: getProfile()
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's profile information.

methods.name: updateProfile(profile)
methods.description: Updates the current user's profile with provided data.

methods.name: listMockTests()
methods.description: Fetches a list of available mock tests.

methods.name: submitMockTestAttempt(testId, answers)
methods.description: Submits answers for a mock test attempt.
